## MLR: Implementation & Tuning

**Purpose**

- Interpretable linear baseline for three-class NQS prediction
- Ridge-regularised multinomial regression (`glmnet`)

**Model Development**

- Fold-wise imputation, dummy encoding and standardisation
- 5-fold provider-grouped cross-validation
- Macro-F1 used for model selection

**Hyperparameter Tuning**

- 6 regularisation penalties × 3 class-weighting strategies
- Best penalty: **λ = 0.003**
- Best weighting: **Square-root inverse-frequency**

## MLR: Cross-validation Results

| Metric | Baseline | Tuned MLR |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Macro-F1 | 0.4003 | **0.4859** |
| Accuracy | 75.47% | 72.92% |
| Below NQS Recall | 0.0% | **10.2%** |

**Key Findings**

- Macro-F1 increased by **21.4%** relative to baseline.
- Moderate class weighting improved minority-class recall.
- Below NQS remains challenging to identify.
